title: Governance intake orchestration for log retention, export, and minimization requests
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Goal: Define an operator-friendly intake and routing protocol that standardizes responses to enterprise requests for log retention changes, audit exports, and PII minimization. This ticket scopes the decision criteria, SLA tiers, required artifacts, stakeholder responsibilities, and response templates. Deliverables: 1) a decision matrix that maps request types and risk signals to routing destinations (support, security, legal, SRE, or engineering), 2) a set of canonical response templates and follow-up tasks, 3) implementation checklist for the Console intake UI and the support playbook, and 4) metrics and dashboards to measure throughput and SLA compliance.

2026-03-01: Engineering review (ENG-22890) flagged need for API for export approvals. Added dependency. Marcus to scope API contract with Eng.
2026-03-04: Design provided wireframes for Console intake modal with required evidence fields. Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/designs/pm-83456-ui.png
2026-03-07: Security requested explicit checklist for KMS/Audit logging for export deliveries. Added to acceptance criteria.
2026-03-08: PM reviewed and updated routing SLA matrix. Ready for cross-functional signoff in next sync.
